summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent: foreign private issuer current report) disclosing purchases of its own book-entry ordinary shares under Article 64 et seq. of Argentina's Capital Markets Law No. 26,831, i.e., a buyback of treasury shares by the issuer and its wholly owned subsidiary Proener S.A.U. On BYMA, CPSA bought 120,000 shares (120,000 ADR-equivalent) at an average AR$2,005.72, totaling AR$240,686,812, traded 2026-10-20 with settlement 2026-10-21. No NYSE purchases occurred; daily volume stayed below 25% of the prior 90-business-day average. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for continuation of buybacks and potential ADR purchases; no change-of-control or arbitrage angle.
